pr_title: Fix bug in Symbol inequality operator
pr_body:
The operator method was returning true when comparing a null symbol against null.

Fixes #1454

issue_context.title: Option Symbols Incorrect Across Splits
issue_context.body:
Trading AAPL options: 

2014-06-09 00:00:00 : | Runtime Error: System.ArgumentNullException: Value cannot be null. Parameter name: key   at System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary`2[TKey,TValue].ContainsKey (TKey key) [0x0000b] in <dca3b561b8ad4f9fb10141d81b39ff45>:0    at QuantConnect.Securities.SecurityManager.get_Item (QuantConnect.Symbol symbol) [0x00001] in <88b912b0fd84484faf8b4c982c08e712>:0    at QuantConnect.Securities.SecurityPortfolioManager.ApplySplitToOptions (QuantConnect.Data.Market.Split split) [0x000a3] in <88b912b0fd84484faf8b4c982c08e712>:0    at QuantConnect.Securities.SecurityPortfolioManager.ApplySplit (QuantConnect.Data.Market.Split split) [0x00009] in <88b912b0fd84484faf8b4c982c08e712>:0    at QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.AlgorithmManager.Run (QuantConnect.Packets.AlgorithmNodePacket job, QuantConnect.Interfaces.IAlgorithm algorithm, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.DataFeeds.IDataFeed feed, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.TransactionHandlers.ITransactionHandler transactions, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.Results.IResultHandler results, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.RealTime.IRealTimeHandler realtime, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.Server.ILeanManager leanManager, QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.Alpha.IAlphaHandler alphas, System.Threading.CancellationToken token) [0x00bd9] in <2516aeb381a54c2a9787b534047df995>:0
comments: Hi @isobretatel; please provide an example algorithm which caused this error;  and the data you used to cause it. LEAN does handle option splits but there may be some oddity with your setup. Thanks
Thank you @dillonricketts. I verified the bug and assigned to @StefanoRaggi, since he knows that code well.

This is a quite tricky one. Actually the symbol objects won't work for options and we'll need to do a refactor of Symbol objects to handle this.. we're still brain storming the best solution but will circle back shortly.

Just an update here - this is a complex issue and we've had to do a work around for now so at least the backtest modelling / equity curves will be accurate (https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/1503).

Long term we may need another data-source to know how the option-symbols are mapped. There is no reliable pattern from the OTCC. 

Leaving issue open until we crack the mapping post-split/renames and solve properly.
Closing as we now close option positions on a split warning.

review_comments: I'm very surprised this bug lasted for so long. Nice fix.
